newsitem.title: USA: Serengeti Eyewear sued by IPO underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Serengeti Eyewear sued by IPO underwriter.

text.p: Serengeti Eyewear Inc Wednesday said a lawsuit was filed against it by Argent Securities Inc, the underwriter of its initial public offering, alleging breaches by Serengeti of provisions of the underwriting agreement.

Serengeti said it reviewed the claims and believes them to be meritless and retaliation for Serengeti's refusal to enter into new arrangements with Argent, including Argent's demand for additional compensation. Serengeti intends to vigorously defend the action and is considering counterclaims.
The company recently completed the acquisition of the Serengeti Eyewear Business from Corning Inc. Serengeti Eyewear designs, manufactures and distributes sunglasses.
